scientific_question: Which high-speed flow region is strongest in the blunt-fin flow field? For this analysis, define high-speed locations as those at or above the 90th percentile of non-zero recorded speed in the stored velocity scale, treat locations connected through shared grid faces as one contiguous region, use peak speed as the measure of strength, and represent the strongest region by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations. Characterize the strongest high-speed flow region.
